Abu al-Darda.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Abu al-Darda.fact: He may have participated alongside the Muslims against the Quraysh at the Battle of Uhud in 627.

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: The _____ was Muslim theologian (874–936).
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.fact: Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari (Arabic: أَبُو ٱلْحَسَن ٱلْأَشْعَرِيّ, romanized: Abū al-Ḥasan al-Ashʿarī; 874–936 CE) was an Arab Muslim theologian known for being the eponymous founder of the Ash'ari school of kalam in Sunnism.

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: Al-Ash'ari was notable for taking an intermediary position between the two diametrically opposed schools of _____ theology prevalent at the time: Atharism and Mu'tazilism
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.fact: Al-Ash'ari was notable for taking an intermediary position between the two diametrically opposed schools of Islamic theology prevalent at the time: Atharism and Mu'tazilism.

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: He primarily opposed the Mu'tazili theologians on God's eternal attributes and _____ createdness
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.fact: He primarily opposed the Mu'tazili theologians on God's eternal attributes and Quranic createdness.

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: On the other hand, the _____ and traditionists were opposed to the use of philosophy or speculative theology, and condemned any theological debate altogether
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.fact: On the other hand, the Hanbalis and traditionists were opposed to the use of philosophy or speculative theology, and condemned any theological debate altogether.

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: Al-Ash'ari established a middle way between the doctrines of the aforementioned schools, based both on theological rationalism (kalam) and the interpretation of the _____ and Sunna
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.fact: He primarily opposed the Mu'tazili theologians on God's eternal attributes and Quranic createdness. Al-Ash'ari set up a middle way between the doctrines of the aforementioned schools, based both on theological rationalism (kalam) and the interpretation of the Quran and Sunna.

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: His school eventually became the predominant school of theological thought within _____
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.fact: His school eventually became the predominant school of theological thought within Sunni Islam.

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: By contrast, _____ do not accept his theological beliefs, as his works also involved refuting Shia Islam
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.fact: By contrast, Shia Muslims do not accept his theological beliefs, as his works also involved refuting Shia Islam.

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.fact: As a young man he studied under al-Jubba'i, a renowned teacher of Muʿtazilite theology and philosophy.

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: The first time, _____ told him to support what was narrated from himself, that is, the prophetic traditions (ḥadīth)

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: Earlier major scholars also held positive views of al-Ash'ari and his efforts, among them _____ and Taj al-Din al-Subki

Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari.question: Al-Luma' Al-Luma' fi al-Radd 'ala Ahl al-Zaygh wa al-Bida' (_____/Illuminations on the Refutation of the People of Deviation/Perversity and Heresies), a slim volume
